description: Equal-host complete production CPython tools/JSON facade plus builtin Unicode database, not the bootstrap-only probe. Generated programs replay only under mandatory bwrap. Production additionally uses a private child; this probe measures complete language+binding footprint without the rest of Tny.
command_log:
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-deprecated-declarations -Iinclude -Isrc -Ithird_party -Ithird_party/yyjson -Ithird_party/picohttpparser -Ithird_party/greatest -Ibuild/generated -DHAVE_ARPA_INET_H -DHAVE_NETINET_IN_H -D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_BSD_SOURCE -DTNY_SHELL_PATH=\"/bin/sh\" -DYYJSON_DISABLE_NON_STANDARD -D_GNU_SOURCE -include src/util/cxx_glibc_floor.h -Os -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -pthread -flto=auto -Itests/bench/code_mode \
    -isystem build/cpython-3.14.7-unicode-final/include -isystem build/cpython-3.14.7-unicode-final/frozen \
    tests/bench/code_mode/host.c tests/bench/python_runtime/cpython_embedded.c src/core/code_python.c src/core/code_policy.c third_party/yyjson/yyjson.c -o build/python-runtime-bench/cpython_embedded -Wl,--gc-sections -pthread -ldl -lm build/cpython-3.14.7-unicode-final/libpython3.14.a -lm -ldl -lm build/cpython-3.14.7-unicode-final/libpython3.14.a 
strip build/python-runtime-bench/cpython_embedded 2>/dev/null || strip -x build/python-runtime-bench/cpython_embedded
